lines.text: They reinvented football. They reached three World Cup finals. And they never, ever won it.
The greatest team the game has ever seen... and the greatest heartbreak. Tonight, its ghost returns.
Last time, we predicted Turkey would edge Paraguay, two to one.
Welcome back to WorldCup twenty-six Legends, episode thirty-five. The Netherlands... versus Sweden.
The Oranje against the Vikings. Two cold, cerebral footballing nations. And stay with me — because one of them changed the game forever.
Two proud nations, forged from the same cold fire. Tonight, only one flame survives.
First, the history. And it is true. The nineteen seventies. The Netherlands, and Johan Cruyff.
They called it Total Football. Every player could attack, defend, create — positions dissolved like magic.
It was the most beautiful football the world had ever seen. The man in the number fourteen made it dance.
Three World Cup finals — seventy-four, seventy-eight, two thousand ten. And three times, they lost.
The greatest team never to win the World Cup. A wound that has never quite healed.
Now meet Sweden. In nineteen fifty-eight, they hosted the final themselves.
And there, they ran into a seventeen-year-old boy named Pele. The dream ended in gold and tears.
But the Vikings have never stopped believing. Cool heads, ice in the veins.
Two nations who think about football more deeply than almost anyone alive.
One built on beauty. One built on steel. Tonight, something has to give.
Now, the Netherlands. Virgil van Dijk — the Colossus, who does not tackle, he simply arrives.
Memphis Depay brings the magic. Cody Gakpo the threat. Frenkie de Jong and Ryan Gravenberch run the show.
Orange fire — elegant, relentless, and still chasing a dream.
And across from them — Sweden. Viktor Gyokeres, the Viking, who scores goals like a blacksmith forges steel.
Alexander Isak glides with menace. Anthony Elanga brings the pace. Lindelof and Bergvall hold the line.
So here is the duel. Dutch beauty... against the most feared striker in the tournament.
Our prediction — built on Dutch class, and on a Sweden side that will make them suffer for every step. Watch.
The twenty-sixth minute. Depay slips it through, and Cody Gakpo finishes low. One-nil, the Netherlands.
But you cannot ignore the Viking. Gyokeres bullies his way through and smashes it home. One-all.
The Colossus, Van Dijk, stands firm. Sweden push, but the orange wall will not fall.
Then, the moment. Memphis Depay curls the winner into the top corner. Two-one, the Netherlands.
Two-one at the whistle, in our story. Dutch beauty edges Viking steel — but only just.
Do you agree? Comment ORANJE if the Dutch take it. Comment SWEDEN if the Vikings strike back.
And that ghost in the stands? Legend number thirty-five: the Ghost of Total Football.
The number fourteen who changed the game forever — and is still chasing the one prize that got away. Collect him inside the game.
Which brings us to you. At WorldCup twenty-six dot world, pick three of the forty-eight nations — and every goal they score, scores for you.
Free to play, no prizes. Like, share, subscribe — the legends are only beginning.
